meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 能帮你做 git 提交和历史调查：按仓库风格拆分原子提交，改写历史（rebase/squash），并用 blame、log 等工具找出改动来源。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码或调查 git 历史时触发，比如你说“commit 一下”或问“这行是谁改的”等。普通代码编辑不会触发。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动拆成几个有意义的提交。
say.note: Claude 会按原子提交分组并提交。

say.text: 这个功能是什么时候加进来的？
say.note: 用 git log -S 等查找。

say.text: 用 squash 把最近三个提交合并成一个。
say.note: 执行 rebase 并改写历史。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude handles git commits and history investigation: it splits changes into atomic commits following the repo's style, rewrites history with rebase/squash, and answers questions like who changed a line or when something was added using blame, log, bisect, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task needs a commit or git-history investigation, such as requesting a commit or asking who wrote something or when it was added. Not for ordinary code edits unless git work is requested.

say_en.text: Split these changes into a few meaningful commits.
say_en.note: Claude will group atomically and commit.
Uses git log -S to trace it.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
